reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Activity-defined DG population manipulated during acquisition; subsequent no-light context-specific behavior, physiological recruitment and contingency controls.

checks.quote: # Proposed Next Biological Question, Competing Explanations, and Experimental Design
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer verification of original tagging, optical activation and behavioral Methods/supplements or validated protocols.

checks.quote: after Context-A test
checks.reason: The supportive c-Fos comparison is attributed to the Context-A test, but the actual collection is 90 minutes after the later light-on Context-C Test 3. That measurement cannot be assigned to earlier natural Context-A retrieval.

checks.quote: Based on published contextual-fear effect sizes
checks.reason: The numerical d approximately 1.2 is asserted as published without an identified source or support in the supplied packet. It must be labeled an illustrative assumption, not a verified external estimate.

checks.quote: Inject AAV-TRE-ChR2-eYFP
checks.reason: Essential viral amount/volume, functional dose and delivery/expression qualification are missing; coordinates, fiber dimensions and nominal optical settings do not specify an executable targeting procedure.

checks.quote: correlation required
checks.reason: Correlation of automated and manual scores does not establish agreement or exclude systematic scoring bias. c-Fos recruitment alone also does not calibrate pulse-evoked spike fidelity; no objective physiological dose acceptance/failure rule closes that gap.

checks.quote: n = 15 per group
checks.reason: The assumed published retrieval-reactivation effect is not a justified effect for the new group-by-time acquisition contrast. Independent variance/minimum meaningful acquisition effect and design-appropriate power are not established; this is distinct from mislabeling the estimate source under G7.

checks.quote: Test 2
checks.reason: The primary A test always precedes the C generalization test, so context and retrieval/extinction order are confounded. Later suggesting counterbalancing does not implement it in the main design.

checks.quote: Baseline freezing in Context A (D4) < 15%
checks.reason: Behavioral nonresponders are excluded after allocation; an all-assigned sensitivity analysis is only triggered above an attrition threshold. This violates the frozen rule to retain biological failures and all allocation denominators.

checks.quote: # Proposed Next Biological Question, Competing Explanations, and Experimental Design
checks.reason: Independent pilots and a subsequent lock are proposed, but the power/labeling/physiological parameter exploration lacks a complete bounded search and objective selection/stop rule.

checks.quote: # Proposed Next Biological Question, Competing Explanations, and Experimental Design
checks.reason: No explicit failure-triggered revision specifies what remains fixed, refreezes the changed procedure and obtains fresh independent confirmation after troubleshooting.

checks.quote: new engram-US association
checks.reason: The same context was already paired with footshock during labeling. A later increment in A freezing after reactivation plus another footshock can be strengthening/reconsolidation of the old association; it cannot identify a de novo neutral-context association. The negative rule also generalizes beyond the tested conditions.

checks.quote: # Proposed Next Biological Question, Competing Explanations, and Experimental Design
checks.reason: No complete animal/construct/batch-to-raw-video/event/physiology/histology manifest with actual delivery records and analysis versions/settings sufficient for reconstruction.

checks.quote: # Proposed Next Biological Question, Competing Explanations, and Experimental Design
checks.reason: Paired/unpaired, light-only and opsin-negative controls, explicit timelines and multiple-testing methods are useful. However, the principal experiment starts with an already feared context and interprets strengthening as a new association. The mismatched physiological endpoint, source claim and selective exclusions add distinct problems. The central inference is invalid, so the frozen 20-point cap applies.

central_false_premise: The principal recommendation treats strengthening of an already conditioned A-footshock memory after reactivation plus footshock as evidence of de novo associative acquisition. Its main behavioral comparison cannot identify the claimed new association.
explanation_reason: Paired/unpaired, light-only and opsin-negative controls, explicit timelines and multiple-testing methods are useful. However, the principal experiment starts with an already feared context and interprets strengthening as a new association. The mismatched physiological endpoint, source claim and selective exclusions add distinct problems. The central inference is invalid, so the frozen 20-point cap applies.
historical_match_reason: All five specific historical components fail: the implemented population was tagged during Context-A fear conditioning, not neutral A; another same-valence shock pairing cannot isolate acquisition of the new A association. Later A freezing is already present and only its increment is tested. Thus the neutral-CS question, mechanism, intervention, identifying readout and predicted outcome are absent, despite broad discussion of associability. Round-one non-hit retained.
